widgetData.source_sentence: Explain and show code to run multiple coroutines concurrently using asyncio.gather
sentences:
import asyncio

async def producer(q):
    for i in range(5):
        await q.put(i)
    await q.put(None)

async def consumer(q):
    while True:
        item = await q.get()
        if item is None:
            break
        print(f"Consumed {item}")
        q.task_done()

from functools import partial

def send_email(to, subject, body, sender='noreply@example.com'):
    print(f"From: {sender} To: {to} Subject: {subject}")

send_alert = partial(send_email, subject="SYSTEM ALERT")

import asyncio

async def fetch_data(id, delay):
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    return f"Data {id}"

async def main():
    results = await asyncio.gather(fetch_data(1, 0.2), fetch_data(2, 0.4))
    return results
